headline: Phalhala or Bust: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Phalhala or Bust is projected #12 of 16 with a 553.10 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Ashton Jeanty, Sam LaPorta, and Rome Odunze. The immediate priority is improving the QB slot without weakening that core.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the QB slot above C.J. Stroud's 47.8 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 59.4 C-AVI would directly attack the 11.60-point projected gap to Gringo’s Goblins.
